trials.title: Shatter the Null Barrier
trials.storyPrompt: Lord Null's barrier pulses with 8 bits (1 to 8). Only the EVEN bits (2, 4, 6, 8) charge your Dragon Prism. Loop through all 8 bits, sum the even ones, and breach the citadel!
trials.objective: Start with shield_charge = 0 and citadel_breached = False. Loop for bit in range(1, 9): if bit % 2 == 0, add bit to shield_charge. After the loop, if shield_charge >= 20, set citadel_breached = True and print "8-BIT RESTORED!".

starterCode.standard:

citadel_breached = False

starterCode.challenge: # Sum even numbers in 1..8 into shield_charge; if >= 20, set citadel_breached = True and print "8-BIT RESTORED!".

trials.testCode:

assert citadel_breached is True, 'Expected citadel_breached to be True'
assert OUTPUT.strip() == "8-BIT RESTORED!", f'Expected "8-BIT RESTORED!", got {OUTPUT.strip()!r}'
